title: Ours came damaged
text:
Ours came damaged. Overall, this is nice and looked like the item pictured. But I had to give it a lesser rating because the fluffy white material inside the hood of ours came damaged. It appeared to be melted in a couple of different places. It was really weird. Had I purchased this outright, I would have returned this; so I can not recommend it.
Also, this blanket hoodie smelled slightly of mildew. A faint scent like that usually will go away with the first washing, so I normally don't think it is a big deal. But thought I should mention it because I could see someone purchasing this as a gift.
